clips.title: The story
paras: West of Darkshire, Brightwood Grove's ruined farms shelter savage Nightbane worgen.

Brightwood Grove lies within sight of Darkshire, where ruined farms and fences mark the town's edge. Nightbane worgen have made crude camps among the overgrown clearings and prowl close to town. Their presence threatens Darkshire, so the Night Watch and travelers passing through keep their numbers down to protect the settlement.
